1: The newer Bespoke Saints English (1).pdf governs, with accepted Genesis 1–11 as the English benchmark. It supersedes the older Founding Style Guide where their pronoun rules conflict: Thou/Thee/Thy/Thine address God directly; ordinary address uses you/your.

Preserved the distinct growth of faith and mutual love, affliction/afflict/afflicted, relief, angels of power, flame, vengeance, eternal destruction, presence/glory/strength, and glory/faith repetitions. Included our in 1:2 from bracketed NA28 wording and smoothed bringing vengeance on. Retained the shorter Lord Jesus title at 1:8.

Our at 1:2 is included from bracketed NA28 wording; the earlier shorter form is archived. From the presence at 1:9 is deliberately retained without deciding source or separation. Eternal destruction is not expanded into a complete account of the mode of judgment.
